description: Defines an enum 'JournalEntryJsonInputParams' containing parameter names used for creating or updating journal entries in the accounting module of Apache Fineract.

classes.name: JournalEntryJsonInputParams
classes.description: Enum storing parameter names related to journal entry operations, including methods to retrieve all values, convert to string, and get individual parameter values.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns all parameter value strings used in journal entry JSON input.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name of the enum value with underscores replaced by spaces.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the string value associated with the enum constant.
